stem:
Megha compares two savings plans that both start with ₹100. Plan P adds ₹100 each month. Plan Q doubles the amount each month.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Both plans are linear growth because both use the number $100$.
Doubling each month is what creates the starting amount ₹100.
Plan P shows linear growth; Plan Q shows exponential growth.
The linear and exponential labels also classify every pair of school marks as growth types.

teacher.key_rationale: Adding a fixed amount repeatedly is linear; multiplying by a fixed factor repeatedly is exponential. Shared starting number 100 is not enough. Doubling does not create the start. Growth labels do not cover arbitrary school marks.
